scope: Refuse explicitly invalid DXF HEADER $LTSCALE values on typed output while preserving tolerant input and the existing absent-value default.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_Header::write serialized an explicit $LTSCALE value directly, while the shared DXF entity writer already rejects non-positive per-entity ltypeScale. Header parsing retains generic scalar values and remains tolerant. The previous getDouble fallback would silently replace a wrong-typed explicit $LTSCALE with 1.0; the new non-consuming preflight rejects wrong group type and conflicting dollar/bare aliases before HEADER bytes are emitted.

normativeEvidence.relevantRule: The global linetype scale factor cannot equal zero.

LTSCALE controls global pattern scaling; CELTSCALE supplies the current object scale; PSLTSCALE/MSLTSCALE and paper/model space also affect display. Linetype definitions are selected from imperial acad.lin or metric acadiso.lin resources.

implementationReadiness.change: A non-consuming DRW_Header preflight accepts absence or exactly one group-40 finite nonzero $LTSCALE/LTSCALE value. Explicit zero, non-finite, wrong-type/group, and conflicting aliases refuse before HEADER emission; missing $LTSCALE still emits the existing default 1.0. Input retains zero for diagnosis and caller repair. Header record output remains transactional, so refused bytes are discarded and a corrected value can be written with the same writer.

coverage: Typed output writes a finite nonzero LTSCALE and emits the existing default 1.0 when absent.
Explicit zero, positive infinity, negative infinity and NaN are atomically refused in both encodings.
Wrong variant type, wrong group code, and simultaneous dollar/bare aliases refuse before HEADER record publication.
Input parsing retains explicit zero without interpreting it as an absent value.
After refusal, the staged output and writer error state roll back; the same writer succeeds with a corrected value.

limitations: Only the documented zero prohibition is enforced for finite values; other CELTSCALE and per-version scale policies remain unqualified.
This tests field admission and byte preservation only. No native linetype rendering, plot scaling, imperial/metric resource selection, or consumer application behavior was run.
No support claim is promoted; native resource/profile and display behavior remains open.
nextReadyPacket: Continue P6 linetype/units readiness by qualifying CELTSCALE, MEASUREMENT resource selection and native pattern display as separate behaviors; do not convert drawing coordinates or LTYPE element lengths from header metadata without source and consumer evidence.
